reviews.review_description: Aria, who assisted with the battery purchase and install booking process, was very helpful. There was a delay in battery stock but I was kept up to date on things, and they refunded my deposit too. I contacted customer support once, and my call was answered fairly quickly and my question resolved.The team of installers from Instyle Solar did a professional job, they left the place clean and tidy, and showed me how to use everything.The SAJ battery has been working well so far, although it has only been a week.

Besides the great initial information gleaned from solar quotes site, the InStyle Solar team provided clear information and details on the system and were professional in the installation and follow up

The whole process has been a positive and  good experience.  Warren the salesrep was fantastic to work with.  The whole team from administration to the technicians who install and salesteam have been great.  Even post-install the team have been in contact to ensure we are happy with the product and everything is working as it should.Would recommend.

The sales rep was not pushy but friendly. The panels were installed and working within a week. The guys who installed them were fast, friendly and efficient and cleaned up their mess.  They helped me to understand how it all works and connected it to our wifi  for me. I can't say too much yet as It has not even been a month but so far so good.

We're only one week post-install so can't really comment on post-install service / customer complaint responsiveness.Quoting process was really good and service agent was knowledgeable and helpful making our decision on what sort of system to install pretty easy, reducing the immense complexity of this subject. Great price for value with a payback illustration of 3.9 years on our system which was very compelling. Communication around scheduling the install was good - installing team arrive around an hour after the initial window but completed before the end of the day and helped us install the app.  So far, we love the app and tracking how well the system is performing.

We Installed an InStyle Solar System in 2017 and the install was good and the savings have been great.  Now we have issues with half of our panels discolouring and indicating possible water ingress.  6 weeks after contacting InStyle. we are yet to get any positive response apart from platitudes from customer service.

Overall the experience was good: they gave a timely quote that was competitive with the others, answered my questions promptly, offered a good deal, and were prompt to get it done once I gave them the go ahead.  The installer was polite and the system was installed efficiently and appears to be working very well.The minor downsides:1) on the day, the installer arrived 40 minutes after the planned time (apparently someone called in sick and they had to pick up a replacement, which I understand but it would've been better if they'd rung to let me know).2) the installer didn't seem to know the fine details of the job (for example he asked if we were keeping the existing inverter - which we weren't - and how many old panels were being removed).3) tidiness wasn't bad, but there were quite a few bits and pieces left on the ground that I picked up (not a huge amount, but not perfect)

Incredibly well organized with great communication skills. The company was a pleasure to deal with and there fitters and electrician were absolutely great. The finished job looks good and is very neat.Highly recommend.

The sales process was really good, I had a lot of questions to ask and the sales staff were excellent. The installation was great the 3 Guys who came out worked like trojans. They cleaned up everything and helped explain how to use the Isolar app on my phone. The customer service and follow up was fantastic I didn't have to do a thing they helped organize the grid connection.
Took the time to come out and discuss. Looked at several options. Explained they were not the cheapest out there but quality of product and install was uppermost

We have recently installed Solar Energy with Instyle. Our experience has been exceptionally great! It all started off with a consult from Scotty who gave us indepth information about Solar Energy. He was so patient, personable and knowledgeable.Our installation was coordinated proficiently and professionally from start to end. The technical team were friendly and very supportive during the installation. The even assisted us to connect to our wifi.Scotty also demonstrated how to use the app which gives real-time information on our Energy yield and consumption. It's exciting to be in control of our electricity supply and usage. We can now actually see and control the products perform.We are able to monitor our usage, generate savings through energy production and contribute surplus energy to the grid which in turn helps out the community. We give Instyle a great big thumbs up ? for service excellence ?

Scott Moore made the sales process really great. Laid all the options out, helped us understand different elements and didn’t push. Installation had a little hiccup, but the guys rectified it the next day. Duane Lee and his crew were really friendly and tidy.

I had Scott come to my house, spend 2 hours going over every possible scenario & thoroughly explaining everything to me. Booking was made a few days later & installation within a month, competitors were 10-14 weeks waiting period. Can’t see the panels from the front of the house which is fantastic. Installers were great to deal with too. Hopefully see a reduction in my electricity bills soon.

Real mixed bag with Nectr / InStyle Solar, who we engaged to do our solar as we are Costco members and they run a decent promo. The quote and quality looked good so we signed up after some consideration. After signing, was told I’d been wrongly quoted on a single phase system and would need a three phase. Was promised that the only change was to panel placement and inverter, so we went ahead. Was promised a pre-Christmas install but ended up being mid-Jan (no big deal, but would’ve preferred the word to be honoured).Installers did a decent job, worked hard, despite some issues mounting the inverter (which a pre-installation inspection could’ve avoided). Happy with the outcome of the install.HOWEVER, a smart meter to measure output and consumption was not included, despite it being on the first (single phase) quote we received. Despite being told “nothing else is changing”, was not informed a key part of my system had been removed from the quote to keep the original price the same.Upon follow up was given every excuse under the sun, told how good a deal I got, and that I should’ve picked the omission up. Finally the company did supply the meter, however insisted I pay an additional $330 for installation of the meter.The system is now fully installed and working well, I’m just really disappointed with the dishonesty and lack of integrity in making their mistakes right.

I had the pleasure of working with Gioel from Instyle soalr to purchase my solar system, and I couldn't be happier with the entire process. Gioel was not only knowledgeable but also incredibly professional and patient in answering all my questions. They guided me through the selection and installation process seamlessly, ensuring that I got the best system for my needs.The installation team that Gioel coordinated was equally impressive. The installers were punctual, efficient, and highly skilled. They worked with great attention to detail and leg the benefits of clean, renewable energy and significant savings on my electricity bills. I highly recommend Gioel for anyone considering solar panel installation – their dedication, expertise, and the quality of their installation team are top-notch!"e benefits of clean, renewable energy and significant savings on my electricity bills. I highly recommend Gioel for anyone considering solar panel installation – their dedication, expertise, and the quality of their installation team are top-notch!"

Highly Recommended company for solar installs !!! swift, kind and caring about all the aspects of there jobs and workmanship. The installers were polite and respectful, they took pride in there work. cannot fault this company or there employees.

After researching several solar companies and feeling overwhelmed by all the offers and lingo, we came across Toben from InStyle solar.He offered after hours appointments which meant my partner and I were both able to make a decision on our investment together. (He also accommodated an interruptive 2 year old young lady during this process with no judgement)Being that Toben has been in the roofing industry prior to his employment with InStyle his advice and experience with in the field shown thru, making us feel at ease.Then the install Thomas the Sparky was wonderful accommodating my migraine and offering contact at a suitable time.There was NO PRESSURE to purchase only support and advice which is why we choose InStyle in the end, also purchased them for our rental property we are that happy.We have no hesitation recommending this company, or it staff.

Sales was very professional and new exactly what he was proposing.Installation was hassle free and very good communication.Customer service so superior to any other company we dealt with.Couldn't recommend them highly enough.

Fantastic company, very efficient and polite sale staff, came out to check the site and explained everything.Installation crew were punctual very polite and never left one piece of rubbish, they explained everything as they worked.Would recommend them to anyone looking for a great company to install their solar

Excellent salesperson for quoting processTradesmen very professional and cleaned up everything before they left.Solar paperwork completed within 24 hours of installation. Even follow up after installation to ensure I was happy with the entire process

Amazing service. I contacted Hugo and my solar installation appointment and payment plan was settled by the very next day, totally hassle free. Sam also did a great job in quick and professional installation of the whole system. They even replaced my old wire strands type fuses with a nice miniature circuit breaker switchboard for free. Unbelievable. Many thanks. Highly recommend them.

We were very happy with the service we received from Instyle Solar. The sales rep was happy to answer any questions we asked and followed up with late queries we had.  On the day of installation the team arrived on time and we friendly and once again nothing was too much trouble. They made sure we understood what was happening and how to operate the wifi side of things.  Instyle Solar are a great company and even after the installation they kept in contact to ensure we were happy and if we had any further questions. They made the whole experience worry free.

Sales staff was excellent, he knew his stuff and listened to what we wanted. The installers were very safe, careful with our house and friendly. They are being very helpful and happy to explain things more than once.
From the sales enquire to getting up and running, the whole process was handled by knowledgeable, professional and courteous team.Highly recommend
Everything went smoothly.  Lovely people to deal with. All connections were dealt with.  I only had to load app to monitor system.

WOW … Instyle Solar simply the best. Exceeded my expectation. From the moment I contacted them on the phone right through to the installation of the solar system and beyond they were there side-by-side with me. They were a phone call or email away. Such a professional organisation to deal with. Their website was so easy to navigate and explained everything you need to know about solar. I have already recommended Instyle Solar to family and friends.

Sales quoting process was friendly and simple.  It was comfortable and easy in our own home.Quite a quick turnaround with installation guys, polite  fast installers but quality. The guys explained the process all the way through installation, prep and them deployment, slick and professional in their process and approach.Finance options make decisions easy also.

I received many offers from multiple solar companies, yet I chose Instyle Solar as they were the only company that cared about the quality of the system and offered the best mix of different components.Solar systems involve dozens of elements that affect the performance of both short-term and long-term. It is very risky to make your system unsustainable and have a lifelong hassle.Marian explained every single element; the solar panels, the battery, the inverters, the conductors used, different warranties, and more!Sam led the installation and took about 5 hours to finish the system on a rainy day!

Their sales and quote was good. They explained they whole process to us, and also gave us an example of our local NRL football club installation.  The installers were very efficient, clean and tidy. They had to stop work due to a massive storm. But continued when it passed.  Customer service was great, the only thing we had to do was organize with the power company to have a smart meter installed.
Great customer service, our consultant was great, always called me back, very informative I've used this company twice. The whole service was great couldn't recommend these guys enough.

I had someone come to my house, look at the roof and talk me through options. He explained the importance of signing up quickly to book installation before STC credits dropped. As soon as I signed up, I got lots of automated emails but I had to chase them for an installation date.On the day of installation, after arriving 90 minutes late, the installer spent 5 minutes looking at the roof and told me it was too steep to work on safely and he was cancelling the job. No apologies. No other options.  There was a month between signing up and installation date. At no time did anyone even mention the possibility that they might have difficulties with the installation.I have made multiple phone calls to speak to someone about this but no one returns my calls. I then received an email from accounts telling me how to arrange a refund of my deposit.I am now back to square one and too late to get this year’s STC rate.
Very impressed with seller of solar panels, electrician who installed etc. Whole installation done very professionally and promptly. Would recommend Instyle Solar to anyone

100% recommend instyle solar. Complete package with exceptional service. Prompt responses, detailed quote, impressive delivery, professional installation and outstanding communication. Instyle solar met more than my expectation. Dont wait any longer get insyle solar to power up your property. Finally my house more sustainable. What a great experience Thankyou

Scott came and visited us to carry out the quoting process. He was helpful and explained the ins and outs of it, so we knew exactly what we were were getting.The Installation team led by Dyane were also great, very tidy install and cleaned up after themselves.The Office team were easy and friendly to deal with.The only issue I had was our install had to rebooked, due to bad weather the first time.When we got a phone call from from the office to try do the job at short notice (the same day) the staff member did not introduce himself, so when I followed up later that day to try book the job in for a Saturday, it turns out that staff member I spoke to earlier that day was the person responsible for booking the job in!!Only a minor issue, but good communication goes a long way.
Very professional salesman.Excellent communications throughout.Installers very good indeed. Friendly, efficient & tidy.

Sales contact was very knowledgeable. Not disparaging about other firms or equipment but had a strong point of view based on past and personal experience. He changed the quoted equipment to meet my requirements and preferences and even suggested financing options not through his business. The process was painless and easy to understand. He also kept me informed throughout all steps in the cycle through to installation.The installation team on the day (there were 3 people) worked quickly and efficiently and kept me across their movements and plans for the day. The handover of the controls (including connection to the inverter via WIFI) was also seamless and explained in detail by the crew on the day.Grid connection was pre-organised and the team at InStyle even walked me through the process of organising for a new meter to be requested and installed by my power company.

Nothing but good reviews for Instyle Solar. Fantastic communication and the installation process was great. Hugo explained everything perfectly and kept us up-to-date step-by-step of the process. I would have no hesitation in recommending family and friends to Instyle Solar. Andrew from Kings Langley New South Wales
The overall presales and installation was not a bad experience.
Easy process from beginning to end. Great customer service. Too early to tell how system is working.

After over 3 years of this installation I haven’t paid a power bill since and was over $1600 in credit until I got a refund of $1200 from AGL which was a nice surprise.Hot water timer switch too is worth every penny.Great job InStyle ????

A great and positive experience from start to finish. They didn’t try to sell us things we didn’t need and we’re very informative!Sales process so simple and straight forward, and the installation process was so smooth also! Very professional and quick!Highly recommend! Even the roof tile place we visited recommended them to us and said how professional they are!

Our Representative was polite, punctual and knowledgeable with a passion for selling the product.All of the setup and applications with regulators was completed easily without any hassle.Installation was delayed due to another job not going to plan ( delay not communicated, not a big issue). When on-site the installers were great - knew what each other had to do and got the job done. Worked into twilight to get the job done.Electricians upgrading power now were on time and polite and explained the system well, but had a slight issue with connection of hot water system but was corrected within 24 hours of notification.Overall, easy ongoing company to deal with for installation of Solar.

Wow! What an easy process! I expressed interest on their website and within 10minutes I had a phone call to discuss my questions. We arranged for a sales rep to come out on my first day off. Unfortunately the day they were due to come, I was sick. With a quick call to the office that morning they arranged my appointment to be via the phone instead. Brad called and went through all the options with me, gave me the prices and allowed me time to discuss with my husband before making any commitments. He then arranged to call back after work hours and we finalised everything over the phone. Today Nathan, Dale and Eric arrived to install the system. From the moment they arrived they were very professional and worked in between the showers of rain to get the job done. Nathan kept me informed during the day, set up the app and explained it and explained/showed how everything worked. I cannot fault InStyle solar and will definitely be recommending them to family and friends.

From our salesman, who spent two hrs, going over everything about how the system works, to how many hrs sunlight our suburb got, by DAY, last year,his knowledge was amazing.The email/text updates we received, as each step was reached were timely and informative.Install day, the text updates of how far, each worker was away from arriving was terrific. The communication was brilliant! The installers were very friendly ,professional, and fast. Oh, and not to forget the young lady, that arranged our salesman, over the phone.I cannot fault the company,up to this point.Highly recommend.

The sales/quoting process was excellent. Very good product knowledge and very informative without being pushy.The installation team were also excellent. Turned up on time and were completed in good time. Very friendly team, even took time to kick the footy for the dog.My customer service experience has been fantastic, well informed and well above what I had anticipated.I would definitely recommend Instyle solar as a solar provider from the experience I have had with them from the very start.They were very competitive on price but had the better product from my research.I have already recommended them to family.

Highly recommend. The entire process was super smooth, minimal effort required on my side. Kept me updated constantly throughout the process and was installed within 2 weeks.If I did have to provide a negative it was only that the sales rep never answered my questions after the sale was completed, even though he said to reach out if I had any questions. This is only minor but if there is another department to contact would have been better to advise to direct all questions to them. I also wasn't pitched or upsold on battery, so I'm not sure how much this would cost if I wanted it in future.Overall, I'm happy with the overall experience, very smooth and stress free experience. Pay a little more for a more premium service and product.

From the first phone consult to the installation was an absolute breeze. Fully installed under 2 weeks.  The information and communication I received was first class. All my questions were answered and I was informed every step of the way where the process was up to.  The app is so good and easy to use. The salesman and installers were great. Would highly recommend Instyle Solar to anyone looking to have it installed.

Very easy transaction from start to finish. I was kept up to date all the time, with all questions answered. Although they were not the cheapest quote, I found that it was money well spent, with lengthy warranty periods on installation workmanship and products. My personal experience was very good, and would recommend using these guys.

Sales made promises that were not followed up, commitment wa  made system would be operational by end of Feb. Beginning of April we still don't have the system we ordered. We ordered a 3 phase system & received a single phase system.Communication has been abysmal at best, it's got to the stage I have contacted the higher ups directly & even they are not contacting me as requested.To say I'm frustrated is an understatement!The battle continues.
How was the sales/quoting process? goodHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? goodHow was the customer service? Rubbish

The whole process from enquiry to install was a breeze. Salesperson was very knowledgable and friendly. Made all details very clear and answered all of our questions.Received updates all the way through as each stage was was passed.Install team were great. Very professional and a pleasyre to deal with and the install looks great.Definitely recommend Instyle for your solar install.
Great service and easy to deal with . Reliable and went through the time to explain how the system and tariffs work.

From the moment Josh arrived to look and provide a quote   during the process and installation and a WALK THRU of WIFI APP.. excellent and complete easy and good to deal with. this time is my 2nd solar panel installation  as first company doesnt exist and had issues.. so  i KNU what i wanted and was looking for a REPUTABLE company that was going to remain for warranty period and bejond

Had a great experience with the team at InStyle Solar.Sales team were clear and detailed in their explanation of the options and the benefits.The onboarding process was excellent and always kept me informed of where things were at from the lead up to installation to on the day getting a text message that the installation team were on the way and an estimate on when they would be arriving.Installation team did a great job and were clear about why we would need to adjust the number of panels we could fit v's the quote (5 panels) and how they could rearrange some panels to not have to reduce by 5 panels, only 2.Several days in now and the system is cranking and the app/website to monitor usage has a great level of detail to help us see our production and usage and help us optimise our power usage to take as much advantage of the solar as possible.

The process of getting solar can be confusing and difficult. However, the team from Instyle Solar made it so much easier. They are with you every step of the way and will answer your inquiry in a timely manner.Most of my communications with Instyle are by email (great for those who dislike talking on the phone), and the only time I had to get on a call is with I make the switch to a different energy provider in the later stages of the process.There are different choices of hardware you can choose from based on your budget, and so far they are performing better than expected.I would recommend anyone to go through Instyle Solar to start their journey on getting solar for their properties!

The salesman had excellent product and manufacturing knowledge, he provided all the detailed information we wanted around the system and comparative products, usage, warranty and was able to answer all our question on the spot. Installation was booked within the estimated time frame, was straight forward, the foreman very helpful providing step by step guidance to set up the software to our wifi and phones. We did have an issue with the system cutting out in the first month however the service team were efficient at responding to our problem and arranging a technician to attend the premises promptly and fixing the issue then and there. Highly recommend.

It was a pleasure dealing with InStyle Solar from beginning to end. The quote process was simple and the agent was able to go into great detail about everything. He certainly knew the business and we were sold. From the moment we signed the contract, InStyle were in contact with us about the process and work was undertaken in a very reasonable time. The process for connecting to the grid was also quite simple, with all steps explained for us.

We initially used InSyle Solar on our previous home and they were fantastic start to finish so much so that we decided to use them again on our next home purchase. Same fantastic service & installation, no issues and very professional. Thanks InStyle Solar

From the first contact InStyle have been fantastic. They took time to understand our needs now and into the future. Rory answered all our questions and helped us work with energy retailer to get the system online post-installation.  The follow-up service has been on point.
The quality of the product and customer service is one of none. Would recommend instyle to all my friends in needs.
Installers were polite and on time, answered all questions and only left when we were properly informed and happly.
Everything from sales to installation to grid connection was perfect
From the information and quoting to the installation, the process was simple and clear..All staff were very polite, knowledgeable and very efficient.I would definitely recommend InStyle Solar

From start to finish was absolute pleasure and easy dealing with sales and technicians that know the best for you and your budget..The technicians did a great job and were very efficient and professional.A massive thanks to the team at inStyle  Solar was an absolute pleasure and you have been recommended to everyone I know when it comes to being connected with solar..
Very happy with the system. From the sales rep quoting to the installer was a very easy process.

Instyle Solar have been nothing but amazing to deal with from the moment we made our first call to organize a quote.The install guys were polite and arrived on time and ran us through how to use everything once installed ????The customer service team has been awesome and are always just a phone call away, and it’s a nice feeling to know that they are also locals and just around the corner if we need anything.The only problem is I’m addicted to checking the app for how much power we are making and money we are saving !!
Great service and quality tradesman. Even worked through the rain. Highly recommend.

From the quote acceptance to final install We were pleased with the communication & coordination of all aspects. Installed as scheduled & operational that day! We had a smaller existing solar system so connection & energy provider actions were all done. System works as proposed & we are generating electricity credit already.
The whole process was seamless and very professional and informative. Could not ask for a more careing company

We have recommended InStyle Solar to our neighbours and friends. From the first contact to the final installation the company and employees have been top notch. There was nothing to clean up after the fellows left and we are more than happy with how everything fell into place after placing the order.

Sales team and staff were friendly and knowledgeable, not pushy, just laid out the info and it all made sense so I decided to proceed. It was just installed last week and the installers showed up on time and were well mannered.

Looking for a Solar Installer. Go no further. Go with Instyle Solar.Good value, prompt, reliable, professional, courteous and helpful at all stages in the process.Willing to take the next step for customers. Would not hesitate to use them again.

Had solar panels installed 4 months ago installed incorrectly had 2 people come and try and fix them unsuccessfully still waiting to find out when someone is coming again to try again welcome to instyle solar

Our installer team was lead by Brad and along with three other members of the team informed us of an approximate time of arrival to commence the install. Right on time they introduced them selves and explained what was the process. I couldn’t fault the team in any way. They went about the install with out a hitch and consulted us on any issue that would affect the appearance of the exterior of the house and undertook the total job in a tradesman like manner and upon completion took all the packaging and rubbish with them.As I said couldn’t fault any member of this professional team and would recommend them to any one considering the install of a solar system by InStyle Solar.

We were impressed with InStyle Solar from start to finish! They were thorough and professional from initial consultation to post service installation. Having a qualified electrician talk us through the initial consult, their own employees and not contractors as installers, and an Australian owned business were all important and reassuring for us. Highly recommend for anyone looking at solar!
Whole  process from initial consultation to installation and follow up was great. Couldn’t fault anything.

From the moment the sales guy stepped into the house we got the feeling he was committed to us and doing the right thing by us, we had a very bad experience on our last solar and had nothing but problems so we were very cautious and spent a long time with the sales person o make sure this was the right purchase and he was amazing he wasn't pushy and didn't make us feel like we were waiting his time, after we signed up there was constant communication about paperwork and installation. The install team was knowledgeable and easy to deal with they were very professional and answered all questions overall a perfect experience thank you instyle!!
Great company to deal with. Great job with installation. Cameron McCarthy was great. Was there through the whole process. Would definitely recommend as a solar company and would use again.

Brian was great to work with and the whole experience was easy. The installers were lovely and quick and professional. Janine and Jayden being there for any advice or questions was invaluable when learning the app and dealing with the electricity company.

I had done some research, so the sales /quote process treated me with respect. The information was as I expected and factual. I had a list and each issue was answered without hesitation.The installation was really good  - Nik was on time the and James were a great team. Efficient and clean are the tow words that come to mind. All questions answered as they went along. I had great confidence in their work because the seem to be on to it and know their stuff.Overall it was a great experience. I am pleased with my choice.

Cameron was a great sales person asked all the right Questions, from Instyle solar the panels came from Canada 20 years Guarantee, same day installation polite, there when they said they would be there, cleaned up no mess,and helped me with grid connection! All up and running now very pleased with Instyle solar
The consultant was punctual, informative and knowledgeable.  The installers were also punctual, polite and efficient and tidy.  Cannot fault the service.
Rory was excellent to deal with. Our installation was very tidy and punctual and kept us informed the whole time.

Instyle were the the only company that arranged a time to have a salesman meet with me directly and go through what I was looking for in the system and particular requirements. This included limited location for the inverter (ended up choosing a micro-inverter system). The salesman was very knowledgeable and had plenty of real world experience that allowed him to quote for an upgrade to my switch board at the same time. This allowed me to coordinate the solar install and switch board upgrade with minimal disruption to our home service.Next the installation - couldn't have asked for a more professional team. They did an excellent job of aligning the panels on my roof and cleanup afterwards, couldn't even tell they had been there.The System is working to expectations and I would have no proper recommending Instyle Solar to anyone.

The sales process was very smooth. Hugo knew what he was selling and although we were encouraged to purchased that day, we did not feel pressured.The installation process was very smooth and the guys were lovely and very respectful to me and my property.The process post installation was explained to us by both Hugo in an email and the installer. The installer wanted to help us set up the Wifi, but we had to buy a booster. We did however call the customer service desk for assistance and Jayden was very helpful.
Absolutely happy with everything. Great customer service. Looks great on the house. Love the black panels. Would definitely recommend instyle solar

Great service from start to finish everything was well explained about the whole process. From type of system we needed and down to every kw we produce and save. Installers were great and were very careful in the whole process to not cause any damage to tiles etc. definitely recommend instyle solar to everyone.

Very easy to deal with. Sales person gave couple  of size options, not pushy at all. We were kept informed at every step as to when they would be here..and they were punctual, friendly n professional in the way they did our install.Recieved word from energex that they had been notified. Emails from Instyle to let us know what to do next once panels were on the roof. Happy customer.
Such a professional company from start to finish. Our 8kW system is doing better than expected.

The sales/quoting experience was amazing, Bryan explained and held our interest and answered our questions well.I was very impressed by the company and our dealings have been prompt, friendly and efficient.
Very professional, answered every question. Best part they actually came out to my house to quote. Installation was a breeze

Fantastic process from start to finish. Bryan was more than helpful. Having heard two neighbours recently use the company for their installs I had him come out to look at mine. There was no hard sales pitch, just a quick, easy to understand explanation. Sign up was easy as well. Installers were on time, professional and very helpful in their walk-through of the system. The job was neat and tidy and quality workmanship. Would highly recommend them.

I rang around and read a lot and spoke to four/five companies. You can tell the ones who know their stuff - and InStyle definitely can answer every question with Authority, but the thing that got me is that Every Person I talked to at InStyle also had real authenticity. Solar is a bit intimidating and they all made me feel safe! Thanks Hugo, James and the nice girl I spoke to today.Must be a good place to work.Angus, Bundeena.

Fantastic experience from  the beginning with mark Cecato the salesman who explained everything . James Oakden and his installation team clean tidy polite. And David Bishop in the office who talked me through the app download and how it works. And the great thing is we have cloud and the system is performing better than we expected .

Initial meeting was informative and the follow up / customer service was good (even after install). The products are from a quality company and the installers are part of InStyle (not subcontractors) and were friendly, punctual and did a good job. Would recommend InStyle to family and friends.

The customer service has been great from start to finish. Warren, the sales rep, explained everything really well. Nate and Mike, the installers, were fantastic, very polite and thorough. I’m really happy with the service
Great experience from start to finish! Dave, Cameron and the installers were very professional and fast. Very happy overall.

Recommend by my cousin. Absolutely enjoyed the process from beginning to end with my InStyle solar panels. The representative who came out to my house to give a quote was warm and not pushy. Another representative via phone, was friendly and courteous. The installers were absolutely amazing updating me on the progress and answering all my questions. Great solar company! Things people should prepare for before getting Solar Quotes and know how much power you use in Sun hours and Night hours as I learnt a lesson the hard way here.  Know how much power you use at night from 5pm to 6am . As Salespersons will talk about your average daily usage off your Electricity account - you need to know when your usage is.  Example : Average account usage per day 32kwh per day - You can run your Hot water, laundry  and Pool in Sun hours but you cant change your usage when you get home from work for cooking and domestic activity and in my case it was half my daily average usage. So the perceived saving of reducing you account can be blurred if you have an expectation that your usage is higher in Sun hours - Make sure you manage the timing of appliances for example our Hot Water is timed for 8am start our pool pump for 10am and I have found in most cases at present the Solar is generating enough to cover the electricity usage plus some. I am total happy with my solar system I am just sorry I didn't do more homework to be better informed about my daily usage for my household.
